objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: List the rsync modules, read /ctf/flag through the unauthenticated share, then get a shell.
hints: Ask the daemon for its module list: no password is required. One module exports the whole file system.
The module is writable and the daemon runs as root; cron runs in the same container. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Identify the service
steps.prompt: Which protocol and port does the daemon serve? (name and port)

steps.title: List the modules
steps.prompt: Which module does the daemon export without a password? (module name)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness class is this? (two words)
